entities.name: Virginia Oldoini, Countess of Castiglione
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Virginia Oldoini Rapallini, Countess of Castiglione, better known as La Castiglione, was an Italian aristocrat who achieved notoriety as a mistress of Emperor Napoleon III of France. She was also a significant figure in the early history of photography.
